topic: Expanded bulk-first CRUD and source-proven batching review

owners.decision: Retain the existing explicit blocking architecture policy without autofix; require no known inspected applicability false positives.
Expand the existing selector to declared compatible reads and CRUD writes, simple comprehensions and eager gather; retain semantic review and no autofix.
Repair shared namespace/member proof and legacy decorator boundaries; retain compatibility alias and duplicate precedence.

review.method: Fifty sequential fresh-context scoped review passes, each with an actual local receipt. Focused probes and repeated fixture variants are not additional independent passes or field observations.

passes.result: Confirmed same-file implementation and declared read-caller gaps; retained existing owners and duplicate precedence.
Confirmed that role inheritance requires a unique stable earlier class binding and conservative dynamic-base handling.
Four executed probes refined the simple typed read-comprehension opportunity and its result-contract limits.
Confirmed narrow create/insert/update/delete pair coverage gaps; preserved incompatible outputs and contextual contracts.
Expanded the existing caller owner; 132 direct AST variants passed. An incomplete builtin timeout remained recorded for later repair.
The typed injected-backend case was covered; per-row effects, transactions and void/aggregate results remained outside the supported shape.
Repaired three builtin source blockers without changing the supported comprehension behavior.
Reproduced the declared compatible write list/dict comprehension gap.
Reproduced the directly awaited, import-proven asyncio.gather gap and preserved opaque scheduler boundaries.
Implemented strict write comprehensions, discarded read loops and narrowly proven eager gather fanout.
Sixteen AST controls passed for typed and imported owners; the inspected service injection remained clean.
Reproduced stale direct receiver proof after alias member writes; positive receiver-alias matching remained deferred.
Reproduced valid stable bound-method adapter rejection and recommended retaining original receiver identity.
Repaired alias-member invalidation with 25 passing probes; recorded separate singleton input-flow defects.
Implemented stable bound-method delegation and reverse tracking; reproduced allocation and immutable-set cardinality false positives.
Reproduced acceptance of wrapped context instead of the uniquely typed bulk collection input.
Repaired allocation, immutable validation, set cardinality and collection-slot proof; preserved per-row transaction and effect boundaries.
Retained advisory semantics for missing rows, duplicates, failure, concurrency and per-row exception or transaction blocks.
Confirmed that arbitrary projection and external effects remain documented review concerns rather than a general equivalence proof.
Reproduced rejection of a directly awaited synchronous helper returning the async bulk coroutine.
Implemented bounded await-result propagation only through exact synchronous tail-return helper calls.
Reproduced a false reverse cycle after rebinding self; required original receiver proof.
Recorded the inherited-singleton/child-bulk limitation and explicitly deferred that optional scope expansion.
Four probes preserved unknown imported ancestry while enforcing locally concrete declared bulk policy; backend equivalence was not inferred.
Reproduced two opposing diagnostic mismatches from non-C3 inherited method ordering.
Repaired original-receiver reverse tracking, bounded C3 ordering, data-model exclusions and concrete local Protocol implementation scope.
Reproduced class-evaluation shadowing of supposedly neutral decorator markers in both strict and advisory owners.
Confirmed separate runtime/test policies and preserved generated, fake, vendor and stub boundaries.
Repaired declaration-time namespace provenance, retaining deferred function, lambda and comprehension scope behavior.
Four probes preserved the documented straight-line adapter limit and simple helper alternatives.
Preserved try/finally, context-manager rebinding and per-row failure or transaction boundaries.
Reproduced reverse edges from provably unreachable statements and literal-false flow.
Pruned direct terminated statement lists and literal Boolean dead paths; repaired inherited instance-write uncertainty.
Contrasting probes retained the explicit CRUD boundary instead of inferring I/O from fetch/load/save names.
Preserved strict scalar/collection write contracts and deliberate per-row effects.
Confirmed existing SQL batching ownership and avoided a second name-only query detector.
Three probes distinguished repeated singleton calls from valid bounded bulk batches; the inspected paged consumer remained clean.
Reproduced async-generator awaitability ambiguity and recommended deferral while retaining visible reverse edges.
Implemented async-generator adapter deferral; cache and dictionary projection controls remained valid.
Extended import-proven immutable builtin scalar handling; 150 AST variants and four cardinality/context controls passed.
Confirmed typed related-entity reads versus bulk prefetch and in-memory identity-map joins.
Preserved optional reads, list/Sequence and keyed Mapping contracts; ordering, placeholders and duplicates still require review.
Reproduced legacy read advice on methods replaced by identical unknown decorators after strict-owner deferral.
Three actual controls preserved exact-code reasoned suppressions, physical locations and quoted pragma text.
Repaired literal builtin member masks, receiver-class mutation and legacy declaration-time decorator proof; 54 direct probes passed.
Repaired stale receiver proof on alias-budget exhaustion; 29 probes covered alias, helper, ancestry and C3 bounds.
Individually reviewed all 93 pre-fix findings: 92 architecture-policy true positives and one fixed-resource aggregate applicability false positive; implemented a narrow source-shaped deferral.
Inspected representative static candidates and ran four controls; no new defect within the supported contract was confirmed. This was not a recall census.
Checked three metadata groups, 16 example ASTs, generated input digests, exact package pins and private-literal boundaries; historical public reports remained immutable.
Fourteen fresh probes passed across aggregate applicability, explicit bulk preservation, mutation and scheduler provenance, cache joins, bound aliases and legacy decorator exclusions.

native_verification.changed_file_preflight: All eight changed Python implementation/generated/test files pass pinned Ruff, formatting and strict typing. Complete builtin source proofs cover the changed files, including the generated descriptor; five inherited tuple-API warnings in the existing shared helper remain disclosed, with no blocking errors.
native_verification.merge_qualification: The canonical pinned make verify command, normal commit/push hooks and latest exact-head required CI including installed-artifact qualification remain mandatory separate completion gates. Their actual completion is reported in the pull request; focused evidence does not replace them.

field_calibration.method: Native run_isolated_corpora with immutable source pins, safe Python import mode and batches capped at 250 files; source analysis only.

original_campaign_baseline.scope: Historical original campaign revision; SARJ421 was not included. This is not the final-main performance comparator.

pre_repair_candidate_review.repair: A fixed-resource aggregate update was a real applicability false positive. The missing-bulk UPDATE-only exception requires a stable own parameterless concrete getter and matching earlier stable same-file data-model return types, with no declared or uncertain CRUD bulk peer.

final_candidate.review_reuse: All retained diagnostics and relevant source bytes match the individually reviewed pre-repair findings; only the confirmed aggregate false positive disappeared.

static_inventory.interpretation: A separate source-only inventory, not a defect count or recall denominator. Twenty top-level files are outside the nested native corpus glob and contain no recognized role owner.

limits: Architecture-policy applicability is distinct from a safe body-only rewrite; tenant/auth, cache, locking, transaction, snapshot, partial failure and external effects still require semantic design.
No natural SARJ516 or SARJ421 match was observed in this final scope. Authored positive cases establish supported behavior, not natural-case recall.
All final findings were reviewed under the explicit architecture policy; finite selected corpora do not establish universal precision or recall.
No application, database queries or remote effects were executed. No measured query-count reduction or proven fleet N+1 incidence is claimed.

performance.method: Five alternating fresh worker pairs, one first and two warm native analyses per worker; same interpreter, dependencies, rules and inputs. Operating-system caches untouched.
performance.sample: Sixteen evenly spaced sorted private corpus paths, eight public Pydantic paths and sixteen current single-file authored examples, materialized outside vendor/cache paths.
performance.stability: Each variant retained identical diagnostics across all fifteen analyses; source bytes, input bytes and original external pins were verified before and after measurement.
limits: Selected16 private and8 public corpus paths by evenly spaced sorted position, materialized outside vendor/cache paths, plus single-file authored examples; performance sample is not a precision sample.
Source-only baseline and candidate use identical installed dependencies; canonical installed-artifact CI owns packaging qualification.
Worker total durations include process startup/imports and all three analyses; first/warm native intervals exclude startup.
Fresh-process first analysis is not cold OS-cache timing. Shared VM medians establish neither fleet throughput nor tail latency.
Peak RSS covers worker lifetime including imports and earlier analysis; not analysis-only or aggregate concurrent memory.

supported_boundaries: Unique stable module-level role classes and bounded local C3 ancestry; inherited singleton declarations and arbitrary domain verbs remain deferred.

Straight-line singleton adapters, stable local bound method aliases, original item/shared context and bounded private helper await forwarding; arbitrary control flow or result projection is not proven.
Caller advice requires a source-declared compatible typed or injected receiver contract. Unknown, rebound, decorated, overloaded, inherited or dynamic contracts defer.
Per-row transactions/effects, filtered or nested result-dependent flow, streams, opaque scheduling and dictionary/cache joins do not establish the supported batch opportunity.

Generated/vendor sources remain excluded; strict runtime ownership and advisory maintained-test policies remain separate. Existing exact suppressions, baselines, severities and no-autofix policy are retained.
privacy: Only redacted aggregates and public repository metadata are published. Private source, identities, paths, revisions, pins and identifying hashes remain in owner-readable local evidence. Earlier public benchmark reports are unchanged.
